scope: All 224 existing registered baseline entities: 216 regular characters and 8 eggs, with 228 species bindings
authority: Existing battle session and frame clock; existing single Pixi stage; DOM owns UI

selector.notification0: currentHp > 0 requests 0, otherwise 15; missing HP is unknown
selector.notification15: 232 reaction/ending CPU cases cover entry selection using field84 and statusCode; later reaction movement and state changes are not implied
selector.notification20: battleEnding == 0 requests raw 33; other or missing ending state does not invent a request
selector.unknown: No request; never map raw slot 33 to a generic attack
selector.equalRequests: Keep elapsed time and active state; ARM9 SetIfChanged does not restart

runtimeProjection.precedence: An explicit nonzero field17C notification precedes temporary committed-move projection; missing operands remain unknown
runtimeProjection.noCommittedAction: Display raw 0 at the current implementation boundary
runtimeProjection.invalidFamily: Static identity fallback; do not invent a move mapping

player.advance: One Q12 4096 advance per battle frame. The existing Pixi ticker accumulates elapsed time at 33513982/560190 Hz; redraw/resize does not advance
player.lateFirstRender: Presentation source samples sequence start on the existing session frame; delayed GPU rendering catches up from that frame
player.forceAndSeek: ARM9 020479A4 -> 0202FA68 -> 0202E144 resets the sequence and seeks an unsigned frame index. An explicit sequenceRequestId can restart the same sequence; redraw cannot. Invalid index retains reset loop start.
player.rawMode2: Loop to source loopStartFrame; discard overshoot as verified by existing CPU receipt
player.reducedMotion: First frame of each requested sequence; action transitions retained
player.unsupportedSpeciesOrAppearance: Keep existing static identity. Never apply baseline geometry to replacement art

geometry.validation: Hash current production files against the receipt and manifest; verify every Main frame
geometry.scale: arena native scale * texture resolution / current frame packed scale
geometry.anchor: current frame packed source origin / current frame logical source size
geometry.position: Fixed source origin based on initial pose native bounds; never re-ground each trimmed pose

specialPrelude.selection: Verified pointer1C 02120900; each caller species supplies raw 33 pose duration and field10+7 restoration frame duration

moveVm.mathBinding: Original Q12 direction, angle-index and vector helpers run in the existing VM host; no Math.sin/cos/atan2 approximation
moveVm.byteMemoryBinding: Optional memoryAccess is consumed by frame construction and native reads/writes; absolute address aliases agree. Ordinary runtime still lacks the full graph.
moveVm.runtimeMovementEdge: 0211C35C owner -> inFlight+E4; 228 species movement values execute original 02114320/0211436C helpers

nativeMotionR6.verified: Ground/air compound-body state, velocity, acceleration, coordinates, fade, pose requests and return values: 936 controlled frames plus 936 original-math frames
nativeMotionR6.projection: Optional getNativeActor projects explicitly supplied stand, heightNativePx, alpha, tintRgb and forced animation requests into the existing source and Pixi scene
nativeMotionR6.reviewBoundary: Fixed starting coordinates and target; direct native-body invocation. No full move-script/AI/contact/projectile encounter acceptance

open: Original launch, approach, return-to-idle and movement timing
Full VM native object graph and effect actor bindings
Original arena camera and world-space positions
Home roster stats, entry conditions and team selection
Replacement-art per-frame geometry acceptance; existing baseline acceptance does not extend to replacement artwork
Native bodies are translated; full child actor and auxiliary VM ownership plus per-move 2D and 3D effect lifecycle remain unbound
Original non-battle action triggers: Raising, Hunt, evolution and capture are separate condition flows
